title: Tiafoe Pulls Off Epic Comeback to Advance to 2026 US Open Semifinals
seoTitle: Tiafoe Pulls Off Epic Comeback at 2026 US Open
subtitle: The American tennis player overcame compatriot Alex Michelsen in a dramatic match lasting nearly five hours.
excerpt: Frances Tiafoe secured his spot in the 2026 US Open semifinals after a historic comeback against Alex Michelsen.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
An epic battle at the 2026 US Open, which lasted over four hours, is among the most talked-about and searched topics. American tennis player Frances Tiafoe pulled off an impressive comeback in the quarterfinals, overcoming compatriot Alex Michelsen after being two sets down. The intensity and drama of the clash at Arthur Ashe Stadium captured the public's attention.

Frances Tiafoe's thrilling comeback

Frances Tiafoe, the eleventh seed, secured his spot in the 2026 US Open semifinals with a dramatic victory over Alex Michelsen. Tiafoe won 5-7 3-6 7-5 6-3 7-6 (10-6), after being down two sets and a game in the third set, with Michelsen serving for the match at 5-3. The comeback began when Tiafoe managed to break Michelsen's serve and took the third set, fueled by the crowd's energy.

All-American duel lasting 4 hours and 38 minutes

The clash between the two Americans, which lasted four hours and 38 minutes, was marked by multiple service breaks and shifts in momentum, especially in the deciding set. Michelsen, 22, making his first appearance in a Grand Slam quarterfinal, showed high-level tennis in the opening sets. He fired 15 winners in the first set, compared to just four from Tiafoe, and his forehand was decisive in key points. However, Tiafoe's experience and the support of the New York crowd were crucial for the turnaround.

Reactions after the intense match

After the match point, a visibly emotional Michelsen was consoled by Tiafoe at the net. The 22-year-old was in tears, while the 28-year-old Tiafoe praised his opponent. "He's quite a player and easily could have won today. Shout-out to Alex Michelsen," Tiafoe said. He also commented on the crowd: "Everyone was asleep in the first couple of hours, me too. As the match went on, the energy was incredible, as it always is. You guys are pulling for me, and I appreciate that." Michelsen, for his part, expressed confidence in his future: "I have plenty of time to grow physically and mentally. I'll be back here. I know that."

Tiafoe's path to the semifinals

With this victory, Tiafoe reaches his third US Open semifinal in five years. He had previously reached this stage in 2022 and 2024, but was defeated by Carlos Alcaraz and Taylor Fritz, respectively. Now, Tiafoe will face the winner of the clash between defending champion Carlos Alcaraz and eighth seed Ben Shelton, in search of his first final in Flushing Meadows.

Other quarterfinal results

In addition to Tiafoe's thrilling match, the day also saw other important clashes. Aryna Sabalenka defeated Linda Noskova in a high-quality battle, with a score of 7-6 (1), 3-6, 7-6 (7). The day's schedule at Arthur Ashe Stadium also featured another all-American battle between Jessica Pegula and Emma Navarro.

With information from BBC, The Guardian.
